title: Japanese Oyakodon
summary: Tender chicken and softly set eggs simmered in a sweet-savoury dashi broth over steaming rice.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Cook rice according to packet directions and slice chicken and onion thinly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Simmer dashi, soy, mirin and sugar in a wide pan; add onion and cook until softened.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add chicken in one layer and simmer 7–9 minutes until cooked through; drizzle beaten eggs over and cover for 1–2 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Spoon chicken and just-set eggs over hot rice and scatter with sliced spring onions.

tips: For japanese oyakodon, follow the cooking cues in each stage rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and accompaniments to taste while preserving the defining ingredients of japanese oyakodon.
storage: Cool promptly, refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 3 days and reheat thoroughly when appropriate.

title: Thai Tom Kha Gai
summary: Creamy coconut chicken soup infused with galangal, lemongrass, makrut lime and fresh lime juice.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Slice chicken thinly; bruise lemongrass and cut galangal into coins.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Simmer stock with lemongrass, galangal and lime leaves for 10 minutes to infuse; add coconut milk.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add chicken and mushrooms; simmer gently 10–12 minutes until chicken reaches 75°C, without boiling hard.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Remove woody aromatics; season with fish sauce and lime juice, add sliced chilli and serve.

tips: For thai tom kha gai, follow the cooking cues in each stage rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and accompaniments to taste while preserving the defining ingredients of thai tom kha gai.
storage: Cool promptly, refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 3 days and reheat thoroughly when appropriate.

title: British Toad in the Hole
summary: Juicy sausages baked inside a towering, crisp-edged Yorkshire pudding with rich onion gravy.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 220°C; whisk flour, eggs and milk into smooth batter and rest 20 minutes.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Brown sausages in a hot baking dish with oil for 12 minutes; meanwhile soften sliced onions in a saucepan.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Pour batter quickly around sizzling sausages and bake 25–30 minutes without opening oven; cook onions with stock and Worcestershire until thick.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Serve puffed pudding immediately with onion gravy and steamed greens.

tips: For british toad in the hole, follow the cooking cues in each stage rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and accompaniments to taste while preserving the defining ingredients of british toad in the hole.
storage: Cool promptly, refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 3 days and reheat thoroughly when appropriate.

title: Indian Dal Tadka
summary: Creamy yellow lentils finished with sizzling cumin, garlic and chilli-spiced ghee.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Rinse lentils until water runs clear; chop onion and tomatoes.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Simmer lentils with turmeric, onion, tomatoes and water for 30–35 minutes until soft, stirring occasionally.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Heat ghee in a small pan, add cumin seeds, sliced garlic and dried chillies and fry until garlic is golden.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Pour sizzling tadka over lentils, season with salt and lemon and serve with rice.

tips: For indian dal tadka, follow the cooking cues in each stage rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and accompaniments to taste while preserving the defining ingredients of indian dal tadka.
storage: Cool promptly, refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 3 days and reheat thoroughly when appropriate.

title: Turkish Lentil Köfte
summary: Soft red-lentil and bulgur patties seasoned with tomato paste, cumin, parsley and lemon.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Rinse lentils and chop onion and parsley.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Simmer lentils in 550 ml water for 15 minutes until soft; stir in bulgur, cover and rest 15 minutes.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Fry onion in oil with tomato paste, cumin and paprika; mix into lentils with parsley and lemon until mouldable.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Shape into small oval patties with damp hands and serve in lettuce leaves.

tips: For turkish lentil köfte, follow the cooking cues in each stage rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and accompaniments to taste while preserving the defining ingredients of turkish lentil köfte.
storage: Serve immediately for best texture; refrigerate leftovers promptly and consume within 2 days.

title: Japanese Chicken Karaage
summary: Crisp ginger-soy marinated chicken bites with juicy centres and a squeeze of lemon.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Cut chicken into 4 cm chunks and pat dry.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Mix soy, sake, grated ginger and garlic; marinate chicken chilled for 20–30 minutes.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Drain chicken, coat in potato starch and fry in batches at 170–175°C for 4–6 minutes until crisp and 75°C inside.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Drain on a rack, season lightly and serve hot with lemon wedges.

tips: For japanese chicken karaage, follow the cooking cues in each stage rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and accompaniments to taste while preserving the defining ingredients of japanese chicken karaage.
storage: Cool promptly, refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 3 days and reheat thoroughly when appropriate.

title: Mexican Esquites
summary: Sweet charred corn tossed with lime, chilli, creamy dressing and crumbled cotija cheese.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Drain corn well if using canned; zest and juice lime.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Heat butter in a skillet over high heat and char corn for 6–8 minutes without stirring constantly.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Remove from heat and toss with mayonnaise, lime juice, chilli powder and a pinch of salt.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Spoon into bowls and finish with crumbled cheese and coriander.

tips: For mexican esquites, follow the cooking cues in each stage rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and accompaniments to taste while preserving the defining ingredients of mexican esquites.
storage: Serve immediately for best texture; refrigerate leftovers promptly and consume within 2 days.

title: French Pommes Dauphinoise
summary: Paper-thin potatoes baked slowly in garlic-infused cream beneath a golden, bubbling crust.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 170°C; peel potatoes and slice 2–3 mm thick without rinsing.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Warm cream, milk, garlic, thyme and nutmeg gently; butter a shallow baking dish.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Layer potatoes, seasoning each layer lightly; pour warm cream over and bake covered 50 minutes, then uncovered 25 minutes until tender and golden.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Rest 15 minutes so the sauce thickens before cutting portions.

tips: For french pommes dauphinoise, follow the cooking cues in each stage rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and accompaniments to taste while preserving the defining ingredients of french pommes dauphinoise.
storage: Serve immediately for best texture; refrigerate leftovers promptly and consume within 2 days.

title: Thai Mango Salad
summary: Crunchy green mango, herbs and roasted peanuts tossed in a lively lime-chilli dressing.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Peel and julienne mangoes and carrot; slice shallot and chilli thinly.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Whisk fish sauce, lime juice and sugar until dissolved; adjust sweet, sour and salty balance.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Toss mango, carrot, shallot and chilli with dressing and let stand 5 minutes.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Scatter chopped peanuts and coriander over salad and serve fresh.

tips: For thai mango salad, follow the cooking cues in each stage rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and accompaniments to taste while preserving the defining ingredients of thai mango salad.
storage: Serve immediately for best texture; refrigerate leftovers promptly and consume within 2 days.

title: Italian Semifreddo
summary: Airy frozen vanilla cream folded with whipped eggs and studded with toasted hazelnuts.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Line a loaf tin with baking paper; chop toasted hazelnuts.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Whisk eggs and sugar over a bain-marie until mixture reaches 71°C, then beat until thick and cool; whip cream separately to soft peaks.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Fold cooled egg mixture, vanilla and hazelnuts gently into cream; pour into tin and freeze at least 6 hours.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Unmould, rest 5 minutes and slice with a warm knife.

tips: For italian semifreddo, follow the cooking cues in each stage rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and accompaniments to taste while preserving the defining ingredients of italian semifreddo.
storage: Store covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 days; freeze only if suitable for the dessert.

title: Mexican Sopa de Tortilla
summary: Smoky tomato-chilli soup topped with crisp tortilla strips, avocado, lime and fresh coriander.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Soak dried chilli in hot water until soft; cut tortillas into strips.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Blend chilli with tomatoes, onion and garlic; fry puree in oil 5 minutes until darker and fragrant.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Add stock and cumin and simmer 20 minutes; meanwhile bake tortilla strips at 200°C until crisp.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Ladle soup into bowls and top with tortilla strips, avocado, lime and coriander.

tips: For mexican sopa de tortilla, follow the cooking cues in each stage rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and accompaniments to taste while preserving the defining ingredients of mexican sopa de tortilla.
storage: Serve immediately for best texture; refrigerate leftovers promptly and consume within 2 days.

title: Greek Revithia
summary: Slow-baked chickpeas with lemon, rosemary and olive oil until buttery-soft and fragrant.

stages.title: Prepare ingredients
steps: Heat oven to 180°C; drain chickpeas and thinly slice onions.

stages.title: Build the flavour
steps: Soften onions in olive oil for 10 minutes, then add garlic, rosemary and bay.

stages.title: Cook the dish
steps: Combine with chickpeas and stock in covered casserole; bake 50 minutes, uncover and bake 15 minutes to reduce.

stages.title: Finish and serve
steps: Finish with lemon juice and zest; season and serve with bread.

tips: For greek revithia, follow the cooking cues in each stage rather than relying only on the clock.
variations: Adjust seasoning and accompaniments to taste while preserving the defining ingredients of greek revithia.
storage: Cool promptly, refrigerate in a sealed container for up to 3 days and reheat thoroughly when appropriate.
